mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.project_id AS projectId, a.title, a.description, a.version, a.category, '' AS equipmentInfo, a.is_submitted AS isSubmitted, a.is_deleted AS isDeleted, a.is_public AS isPublic, a.approved, a.submitted_by AS submittedBy, a.approved_by AS approvedBy, a.submitted_at AS submittedAt, a.approved_at AS approvedAt, a.submitted_by_name AS submittedByName, '' AS projectTitle FROM archives a WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.approved = TRUE AND a.is_submitted = TRUE ORDER BY a.approved_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archives ( project_id, title, description, version, category, is_submitted, is_deleted, is_public, approved, submitted_by, submitted_by_name, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{version}, #{category}, #{isSubmitted}, false, #{isPublic}, false, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedByName}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.project_id AS projectId, a.title, a.description, a.version, a.category, '' AS equipmentInfo, a.is_submitted AS isSubmitted, a.is_deleted AS isDeleted, a.is_public AS isPublic, a.approved, a.submitted_by AS submittedBy, a.approved_by AS approvedBy, a.submitted_at AS submittedAt, a.approved_at AS approvedAt, a.submitted_by_name AS submittedByName FROM archives a WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE archives SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, is_public = #{isPublic}, is_submitted = #{isSubmitted}, version = #{version}, project_id = #{projectId}, submitted_by_name = #{submittedByName} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_files ( archive_id, file_name, original_file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, download_count, is_deleted, uploaded_at ) VALUES ( #{archiveId}, #{fileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{downloadCount}, #{isDeleted}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, archive_id AS archiveId, file_name AS fileName, original_file_name AS originalFileName, file_path AS filePath, file_type AS fileType, file_size AS fileSize, download_count AS downloadCount, is_deleted AS isDeleted, uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM archive_files WHERE archive_id = #{archiveId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC

SELECT id, archive_id AS archiveId, file_name AS fileName, original_file_name AS originalFileName, file_path AS filePath, file_type AS fileType, file_size AS fileSize, download_count AS downloadCount, is_deleted AS isDeleted, uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM archive_files WHERE id = #{fileId}
mapper.update: UPDATE archives SET approved = TRUE, approved_by = #{adminId}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
